The '''''Ultima''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial'' I-class Star Destroyer]].

==History==
It participated in a blockade of [[the Graveyard]], which was set as a trap by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to capture the heroes from the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]'' {{Reprint|Graveyard of Alderaan}}
